summary: iPortal recorder UI refinements in the shared workstation (every recorder domain): the input meter uses the console's calibrated dBFS VU scale (RMS bar, peak-hold marker, station minimum read-only); preview is a Play/Pause/Resume + Stop transport (Stop and a natural end return to 0); waveform wheel, trackpad and touch zoom/pan. No migration, service unit, package, nginx or protected-runtime change; collectstatic and a Gunicorn restart only.
